name: family-tree
description: A private family-history site on your own Cloudflare account: interactive tree, research tracking and AI research agents, behind Cloudflare Access.

DB.description: The family tree: people, families, sources, research and edit history. A new, empty database is created for you; migrations run on every deploy.

MEDIA.description: Private photos, documents and reports. Files are only served to people signed in through **Cloudflare Access**.

AI.description: Workers AI, used by the optional research agents and page assistant.

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:agents
scripts.preview: python3 tools/build.py && npm run build:web && python3 tools/serve.py
scripts.db:load: python3 tools/guard_load.py --remote --legacy && wrangler d1 execute DB -c wrangler.local.jsonc --remote --file build/seed.sql
scripts.db:load:local: python3 tools/guard_load.py --local --legacy && wrangler d1 execute DB -c wrangler.local.jsonc --local --file build/seed.sql
scripts.dev: npm run build:web && npm run build:agents && wrangler dev -c wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.db:counts: wrangler d1 execute DB -c wrangler.local.jsonc --remote --command "SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM people) AS people, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM families) AS families, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM findings) AS findings"
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB -c wrangler.local.jsonc --remote
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB -c wrangler.local.jsonc --local
scripts.db:import: python3 tools/guard_load.py --remote && wrangler d1 execute DB -c wrangler.local.jsonc --remote --file build/seed-app.sql
scripts.db:import:local: python3 tools/guard_load.py --local && wrangler d1 execute DB -c wrangler.local.jsonc --local --file build/seed-app.sql
scripts.deploy:ci: node tools/ci_config.mjs && node tools/wait_migrations.mjs && npm run build:web && npm run build:agents && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.ci.jsonc
scripts.upload:ci: node tools/ci_config.mjs && npm run build:web && npm run build:agents && wrangler versions upload -c wrangler.ci.jsonc
scripts.build:agents: test -d agents/node_modules || npm --prefix agents ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix agents run build
